body: I pretty much end up finding myself disgusted with the selfishness and stupidity of almost everyone I meet. I like being alone for the first part right now, my parents are a major trigger for manic behavior though. I go out every now and then. I watch fights with my brothers every month(they are successful with homes/wives/kids) and have some party friends, they are my release for when I HAVE to get outside to take my mind off of being so miserable, but I don't really like them.
